The applied half of an artifex is the magically imbued @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.6iauipFjk1aW7w83]{Artifex's Medium} they use to create magic. For most luminaries, the medium is a personal choice that aligns best with their talents or are trained to use. An artifex uses their medium to envision and conceptualize the magic they intend to create. Each medium has their unique qualities, with benefits and drawbacks that the artifex works around. You select an artifex’s medium at 1st level, which affects the outward methods and outcomes of your spellcasting.

Selecting an artifex’s medium determines your key attribute score and your artifex’s skill, which is essential to artifex actions and spellcasting. It also grants you a Catalyst Action, which gives you an alternative use for your Ephemeral Catalyst. The medium can take many different forms, but functionally they act as an implement you hold in one hand, and you must hold this implement to be able to perform your spellcasting. If you ever lose your medium, you can acquire a new one through common items in any settlement or make your own after a day of downtime at negligible cost. The list of mediums are:

  • @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.OIvbhw8Bb1W1eNSs]{Rain of Colours}

  • @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.SdImCOvuizyYanYx]{Inks and Icons}

  • @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.ZonxcfyboMpti0CW]{Smoke and Mirrors}

  • @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.gM8NMpanEfjRwbvB]{Standing Oration}
